info.title: BidiLint — lint localization files for bidi (bidirectional text) pitfalls.
info.description: Lint RTL localization files for bidi pitfalls: missing keys, unisolated Latin runs, mixed numeral systems, and unbalanced isolates. Supports JSON, .resx, Android, Apple .strings, gettext, and Flutter ARB.

options.name: --base
options.description: Base culture other cultures are compared against (default: en).

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings as failures too. Errors always fail.
